core.decision_scope: Literal proposition reconstruction only; no source-equivalence, proof-validation, verification, source-review or completion decision.

hash_recipe.artifact_recipe: SHA256(exact native file bytes); the manifest does not contain its own raw hash
hash_recipe.canonical_encoding: UTF-8, no BOM; JSON with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True and separators=(comma,colon), no added whitespace or final newline
hash_recipe.decoder_run_recipe: SHA256(canonical JSON of run-manifest.json core only); decoder_run_sha256, hash_recipe and output_artifacts are outside core and excluded
hash_recipe.packet_recipe: SHA256(canonical JSON of packet after removing the top-level packet_sha256 field))
hash_recipe.reconstruction_recipe: SHA256(exact reconstructed_theorem string encoded UTF-8, no normalization and no added newline)
